fullDescription: A standalone timeline COMPONENT for a marketing or product page: A horizontal roadmap rail with pill badges and three states: shipped, in progress and planned. Dots sit on a single rule, each with a pill badge, a title and a short line. The fill animates in once when the rail enters view and then holds at the live step; it reports a state about the product, so tracking scroll position would make a progress bar that lies. Collapses to a left-rail vertical list under 760px. Built in the light shadcn register (ground #FAFAFA, cards #FFFFFF, hairline #E4E4E7, one indigo #4F46E5, Inter throughout) so it drops into an existing design system without a restyle. No images, no libraries and no build step; avatars are drawn from initials. About 5KB, responsive to 390px, and it degrades to something genuinely readable under prefers-reduced-motion rather than freezing.
prompt:
## Resumo
A self-contained timeline component. A horizontal roadmap rail with pill badges and three states: shipped, in progress and planned. Dots sit on a single rule, each with a pill badge, a title and a short line. The fill animates in once when the rail enters view and then holds at the live step; it reports a state about the product, so tracking scroll position would make a progress bar that lies. Collapses to a left-rail vertical list under 760px. The page contains the component and nothing else, so it can be lifted straight into a section.

## Estilo Visual
Ground #FAFAFA, card #FFFFFF, ink #09090B, muted #71717A, border #E4E4E7, accent #4F46E5. Inter 400 for body, 600 for names and titles, 700 for the heading. Radii 12 to 16px, borders 1px, and a single 0 1px 2px rgba(9,9,11,.04) lift on cards. Draw avatars from initials on a coloured disc rather than loading images, so the component has no asset dependency. Ease everything with cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1).

## Layout e Estrutura

### Component
Dots sit on a single rule, each with a pill badge, a title and a short line. The fill animates in once when the rail enters view and then holds at the live step; it reports a state about the product, so tracking scroll position would make a progress bar that lies. Collapses to a left-rail vertical list under 760px.

### Responsive
Reflow rather than shrink: horizontal rails become vertical rails, multi-column grids drop columns progressively, and nothing is allowed to overflow the viewport at 390px.

### Reduced motion
Under prefers-reduced-motion, remove the motion mechanic entirely and show a plain readable equivalent. A magnifying rail or a rotating ring frozen mid-animation is unusable; a list is not.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
A horizontal roadmap rail with pill badges and three states: shipped, in progress and planned.

### Componente
Initial-based avatars with no image dependency

### Componente
Reduced-motion fallback that changes the layout, not just the timing
